EUR transfers to and from SEPA countries now settle within one business day under automated straight-through processing, on a SHA/SHAR fee split (sender pays their bank, recipient pays theirs) with intermediary-bank costs eliminated. Offered to retail, entrepreneur and corporate clients.

verified_signals.entity: National Bank of Serbia / OTP banka Srbija
verified_signals.signal: NBS's new Decision on conditions and procedures for establishing and verifying the identity of natural persons by electronic communication means, Official Gazette RS 43/2026, replaces the 2019 decision (Gazette 15/2019, 84/2020, 49/2021) and governs remote video identification. It provides for direct (live video with staff) and indirect (automated) video identification; institutions must notify NBS at least 30 days before launching, and NBS can order suspension of video-identification procedures where it finds irregularities. Existing users get six months to align procedures and internal acts, and one year to adapt technical solutions, from entry into force. OTP banka a.d. Novi Sad appears on NBS's published register of entities that have filed notice and documentation for video identification; the bank already runs video-call onboarding for its Fluo, Praktik and Prestiz packages via a c.15-minute agent call.
verified_signals.source_name: Narodna banka Srbije - Propisi iz oblasti sprecavanja pranja novca (Gazette citation); NBS - Lista obveznika ... za sprovodjenje postupka video-identifikacije; OTP banka Srbija - Online otvaranje racuna; Biznis.rs
verified_signals.implies: A hard technical-adaptation deadline on a live eKYC channel that OTP is confirmed by the regulator to operate - Printec digital onboarding/eKYC, liveness and document verification and AML risk-scoring all in scope, with the one-year technical deadline as the forcing event.
verified_signals.likelihood: Medium-High - regulatory deadline on a channel OTP demonstrably runs
verified_signals.followup: Pin the exact entry-into-force date of Gazette 43/2026 to derive the hard technical deadline - the six-month and one-year clocks run from it and I could not establish it. Then approach on the technical-adaptation deadline specifically.
verified_signals.verifier_note: This signal was materially UNDER-sold by the researcher, who tagged it press-tier and Low. I upgraded it on primary evidence. (1) Gazette citation confirmed on NBS's own propisi register, which lists 'Odluka o uslovima i nacinu utvrdjivanja i provere identiteta fizickog lica koriscenjem sredstava elektronske komunikacije - NOVO - Sluzbeni glasnik RS, br. 43/2026' directly above the superseded 15/2019, 84/2020, 49/2021 version. That resolves the researcher's own open followup and operator request #3 as to the Gazette number. (2) Far stronger: NBS publishes a register of entities cleared for video identification, and 'OTP banka a.d. Novi Sad' is ON IT - regulator-tier confirmation that OTP actually operates the channel, which the researcher had only inferred from the bank's marketing page. (Chip Card also appears on that register.) (3) OTP's own onboarding page confirms the video-call flow and the '15-ak minuta' agent call for Fluo/Praktik/Prestiz. (4) The six-month/one-year adaptation deadlines and the 30-day pre-notification are confirmed in the Biznis.rs report dated 11/05/2026 - I corrected source_date from 30/07/2026 (which was merely the researcher's access date) to 11/05/2026. Source tier raised press->regulator and confidence Low->Medium accordingly. STILL OPEN: the entry-into-force date, which I could not find, so the actual deadline cannot be computed - flagged in residual gaps. I did not verify the researcher's specific exclusions (high-risk clients, offshore entities, AML-deficient jurisdictions) or the C1-English staff requirement against the decision text, so I removed those details rather than carry them unchecked.

I probed a range of nbs.rs showcontent IDs without a hit; the Politika article that surfaced for the Q1-2026 NBS release covers instant payments only and carries no ATM count; a second targeted search failed to return the 3,336 figure and instead surfaced 3,219 for end-March 2025. Only the Q3-2025 figures (3,197 ATMs, -0.4% y/y; over 180,000 POS, +17% y/y) are regulator-verified. The end-2024 figure of 3,218 could not be corroborated at all and was removed from the signal. This is the single highest-value missing date in the unit and remains operator request #3. (3) OTP banka Srbija standalone financials - /o-nama/godisnji-izvestaji/ still renders only 2019-2020 filings and /izvestavanje/ report links are JS-injected, so no verified 2025 assets/profit/market-share row exists.
